question: How many copies of histone H3 will there be in chromatin with 200 chromatosomes ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Histone H3" -> "One histone H3 per chromatosome" -> "200 histone H3 for 200 chromatosomes" -> 100%
analysis: Each chromatosome contains two copies of histone H3, so with 200 chromatosomes, there will be a total of 400 copies of histone H3 in the chromatin.
